summary: Explored the @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent package internals to understand extension, settings, package-manager, and trust-manager APIs. Read AgentSession types, extension runner implementation, docs (extensions/sdk/packages/settings), package-manager resolve flow, trust-manager store, and model-runtime provider registration. Also surveyed how the host app consumes resources, skills, and extensions via AgentStore.svelte.ts and the session-repository.
